newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves through 3-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves through 3-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system on Monday through three-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"We're looking for a system RP today ... And our best guess on the term is three days," said Dana Saporta, economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International Inc also expect the Fed to add reserves via term system RPs.
Saporta estimated the Fed's daily add need for the remaining 10 days of the current two-week maintenance period at about $3 billion. (( -- J.P. Vicente, 212-859-1676 ))
